candidates.explanation: The max-size check has an inverted comparison. It uses `file.fileSize < maxFileSize`, so any file smaller than the limit (such as a 200 KB png) throws PayloadTooLargeException. Files larger than the limit pass, which is why the 20 MB file gets a signed URL. The condition should be `>` (reject only when fileSize exceeds the max).

fix.description: Change the comparison operator from `<` to `>` so the error is thrown only when file.fileSize is greater than file.maxFileSize: `if (file.fileSize > (this.configService.get('file.maxFileSize', { infer: true }) || 0))`.
